newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures firm late, finish mostly higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures firm late, finish mostly higher.

text.p: Oct 23 - U.S. debt futures firmed late, most end firm. T-bond, Euro traders tied late upmove to widespread, unconfirmed talk of Fed buying cash five-year notes for foreign central bank customer. They also noted relief supply out of way. Some said five-year note sale was in-line but non-comp bids on low side. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
